items.title: Oil Prices Fall Below $80. Why That Could Make Exxon a Buy.
items.summary: Oil prices settled at their lowest levels since early March on Tuesday after President Donald Trump said the crucial Strait of Hormuz will reopen for commercial shipping as soon as Friday.  The sharp drop in oil prices and oil stocks Monday led BofA analysts to scope out a buying opportunity for  Exxon  Mobil, which fell 4.1% Monday, as other energy firms like  Valero Marathon Petroleum Phillips 66  and  Exxon  all took a hit.  The analysts upgraded the stock from Neutral to Buy, writing, “At today’s price of $141/share, it is lower than when the Iran War began, despite clear net upside from the war’s impacts.”
